clauses.explanationTr: Arbitrajı tamamen reddedemezsiniz; sadece değişiklikleri reddedebilirsiniz, ancak hâlâ bireysel, sınıf olmayan arbitraj zorunlu olur.
clauses.quote: Opting out of a material change to the Arbitration Agreement is not an opt-out of arbitration altogether. Even if you opt out of a material change to the Arbitration Agreement, you and Spotify agree that any Dispute will be determined by binding individual (not class) arbitration in accordance with the Arbitration Agreement in effect immediately before any such opt-out.

clauses.explanationTr: Şirket, şartları tek taraflı olarak değiştirebilir ve değişiklikleri kabul etmek için hizmeti kullanmaya devam etmeniz yeterlidir.
clauses.quote: We may make changes to these Terms (including any additional Spotify terms and conditions incorporated by reference herein) from time to time by notifying you of such changes by any reasonable means, including by posting the revised Terms on the applicable Spotify Service ... Your use of the Spotify Service following any changes to these Terms will constitute your acceptance of such changes.
